---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect measurements, outputs or application behavior
labels: bug
---

## Reproduction

Include the command or a short script. Use synthetic audio if you can.

## Expected and actual results

For measurement changes, include units and any known reference value.

## Environment

OpenAudioKit version, Python version, operating system, and optional extra in use.

For desktop bugs, include the display scaling, audio backend or output device if relevant, and UI language. For codec bugs, include the container and subtype.
